hero.title: Pricing and plans
hero.subtitle: 321 School is built so everyone can learn for free. When you need more capacity, more AI features, and more collaboration, you can upgrade to the plan that fits your role.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: Get started for free with library access, reading, and simple use.

basic.name: Basic
basic.tagline: For those who want to use the platform more often and get more capacity.

plus.name: Plus
plus.tagline: More AI, more collaboration, and access to the most important premium features.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: For high activity, publishing, and more professional use.

card.disclaimer: * Prices and content may be adjusted before launch.

howItWorks.title: How does this work in practice?

categories.title: One shared pool per category
categories.body: Premium generators, AI feedback, images, and downloads are counted in separate monthly pools.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and plans are aligned
dashboard.body: The numbers you see in your dashboard and in the generators should match the limits in your plan.

roles.title: Roles have different value
roles.body: Student, teacher, and parent get different limits because they use the platform differently.

plus.title: Plus is the bridge to premium
plus.body: Plus is made for users who need more capacity, but not full professional use.

student.title: 🧑‍🎓 Student
student.subtitle: Perfect for self-study, practice, and collaboration.
student.hint: Student plans are built around a shared premium generator pool per month. The same pool is used when you create premium tasks, texts, and similar tools.

teacher.title: 👩‍🏫 Teacher
teacher.subtitle: Built for teachers with clear limits per plan.
teacher.hint: Teacher plans use the same model as your dashboard: a shared premium generator pool, separate limits for AI feedback, images, downloads, and members.

generators.label: 🧠 Premium generators / month
generators.note: Shared pool for lesson, reading test, quiz, writing task, and more

parent.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Parent
parent.subtitle: For home training, support, and progress monitoring.
parent.hint: Parent plans also use a shared premium generator pool, along with separate limits for AI feedback, images, and downloads.

footer.note: This is a living pricing page under development. Numbers, limits, and content may be adjusted before launch. The CTA buttons can be connected directly to Stripe checkout or the billing page.
